name: Sturm

frame.name: Accomplice
frame.description: Final blows with this weapon fill the magazine of the equipped Energy weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.description:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.description:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Storm and Stress
perks.description: Final blows with Together Forever weapons reload this weapon and overflow bonus damage rounds into the magazine. Final blows with bonus damage rounds increase the magazine capacity of Together Forever weapons.

perks.name: Combat Grip
perks.description:
This weapon's recoil direction is more vertical.
  •  Greatly controls recoil

flavor: These ancient ceremonial pistols can be dated back to the early Golden Age. A faded inscription reads, "To Sigrun, from Victor."
